title: Prime Minister shares an article on India’s growth as a global tourism destination
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has shared an article written by Union Minister Shri Gajendra Singh Shekhawat.
The article highlights India’s rise on the global tourism map, supported by better connectivity, improved tourist facilities and easier digital access. It notes that this growth is opening new opportunities for local businesses, guides, artisans and communities.
The article further highlights sustainability as a key focus for the next phase of tourism, connecting India’s rich heritage with economic opportunity while creating better experiences for travellers.
The Prime Minister’s Office said in X post;
“India’s rise on the global tourism map reflects better connectivity, improved tourist facilities and easier digital access, writes Union Minister @gssjodhpur. This growth is opening new opportunities for local businesses, guides, artisans and communities.
With sustainability at the heart of tourism’s next phase, India is connecting its rich heritage with economic opportunity as well as creating better experiences for travellers.”
